newsitem.title: FRANCE: DMC loses nearly 10 percent in two days.
newsitem.headline: DMC loses nearly 10 percent in two days.

text.p: Shares in textile firm DMC were down nearly six percent in late trading on Monday on continuing disappointment with a 14 percent drop in its nine-month sales and loss forecast for the year.
The share was down 7.40 francs at 122 at 1320 GMT, bringing its loss in the past two sessions to nearly 10 percent.

The group announced lower nine-month sales on Thursday evening, adding that it expected to cut 1,500 jobs, and its chairman forecast a full-year loss of around 550 million francs in a newspaper interview on Friday, citing weak business. DMC reported a first-half loss of 144 million francs.
One analyst said the group's profit margin skidded to 1.8 percent last year from seven percent in 1990.
He said the group suffered not only from weak consumer spending but also from a failure to relocate more of production outside France to lower its costs.
